name: @local/dsh-commandcode-proxy
description: Keeps the local Command-Code reverse proxy (proxy.mjs) running for as long as the DSH profile is loaded, and adds a Command-Code usage section to Settings.

meta.title: Command-Code 代理与用量
meta.description: 随 DSH 启动本地 commandcode-proxy 反代（默认 127.0.0.1:3050），并在设置中提供 Command-Code 用量面板。
